cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say yes to the garden-party date before the hold expires. We secure the venue before we design the event.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests are you planning?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's capacity planning, a later stage. Please don't begin with chairs when we haven't confirmed a garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't agree without seeing the price.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll open the quote while you confirm. Approval first, cost review immediately after; let's keep the stages in order.

reason: Make A exacting planning phases serve the drive to secure approval before guest and cost consequences, with B clear refusal driving a faster proposed sequence.
